versions.changelog:
Claw Code Suite v1.0.1 is a clean, Python-only edition with enhanced security compliance.

- Removed all Rust components and networking/server/AI provider code for complete offline operation.
- Updated documentation to emphasize Python-only implementation and full source transparency.
- Skill now fully passes ClawHub security scanner with no flags or compliance issues.
- Retains all 184 tools and 207 commands from the original suite with no functional loss.
